comment: A DOI among the alternate identifiers (GBIF gives every dataset one) is the record's @id, as https://doi.org/<doi>.
A GBIF dataset key becomes https://www.gbif.org/dataset/<key>.
A URL is kept; anything else becomes urn:eml:<packageId>.
A PropertyValue: propertyID the identifiers.org doi entry, url https://doi.org/<doi>.
A PropertyValue whose propertyID is the eml system attribute (http://gbif.org, knb), else 'packageId'.
Every alternate identifier but the one used as schema:identifier: a URL as is, a DOI as its resolver URL, anything else as text.
The landing page EML points to.
With no information URL, the DOI's resolver URL.
Else the GBIF dataset page. With none of these, schema:url is the OGC nil URI.
The first title.
Titles after the first (EML repeats title per language), and the shortName.

In order, as a JSON-LD @list. An individualName makes a Person (givenName surName, affiliated to the organizationName), else an Organization; positionName alone names a role-holder Person. electronicMailAddress, phone and onlineUrl become a contactPoint; a userId with an ORCID or other directory its identifier. A <references> element is followed to the party it names.
Built as for a creator.
A schema:Role with roleName 'contact' (EML's required point of contact).
A schema:Role whose roleName is the party's EML role (principalInvestigator, custodianSteward, ...).
A schema:Role whose roleName is the personnel role.
The first metadata provider maintains the catalog record.
EML 2.1's funding is free text: a MonetaryGrant whose description is the text. Empty or placeholder funding (GBIF's IPT writes NA) is skipped.
As written: a date or a year.
EML has no revision date for the dataset; the publication date stands in.
A year alone padded to YYYY-01-01, as the ISO and DataCite converters do. With no pubDate, dateModified is the sentinel 1900-01-01.
When GBIF wrote the EML document: the catalog record's date, not the dataset's.
As written (GBIF writes ENGLISH, others ISO 639 codes).

subject_xpath: dataset/abstract | dataset/purpose | dataset/additionalInfo | dataset/project/title | dataset/project/abstract | dataset/project/studyAreaDescription | dataset/project/designDescription
comment: The abstract, then the purpose, additional information and the project (title, abstract, study area, design), each labelled. With none, the description is the name.
A DefinedTerm in the set's keywordThesaurus when it names one (not N/A), else a string.
Each taxon as a DefinedTerm: taxonRankValue is its name, the rank its description, commonName its alternateName.
A CreativeWork at the licence url, named by licenseName; the SPDX identifier is its identifier.
A licence linked from the rights statement (GBIF's CC links).
The rights statement as text. With neither a licence nor a statement, schema:license is the OGC nil URI.
A Place: geographicDescription is its description; boundingCoordinates a GeoShape box (S W N E), or GeoCoordinates when the box is a point.
rangeOfDates as an ISO 8601 interval (begin/end calendarDate), singleDateTime as a date.
Each method step, the sampling description (study extent and sampling description) and quality control as a cdifProv Action whose actionProcess is the text.
The citation GBIF asks users to give.
A LinkRole (linkRelationship 'bibliography') to each publication whose identifier resolves (DOI, URL); the citation text is the target's name. A citation with no identifier is dropped.
A DataDownload at the URL (GBIF: the Darwin Core Archive or the IPT resource).

A DataDownload and cdi:TabularTextDataSet: contentUrl from physical/distribution, name entityName, description entityDescription, the simpleDelimited field delimiter, quote character and header lines, and one cdif:PhysicalMapping per attribute in column order.

Each attribute a cdi:InstanceVariable: attributeName its name, attributeLabel its alternateName, attributeDefinition its description, the standard or custom unit its unitText, and an XSD type from storageType, else the measurement scale's number type. Identified as #<attributeName>, prefixed with the table's position when there are several tables.
Update frequency and maintenance notes have no CDIF property; not converted.
Code lists and missingValueCodes are not converted yet.
Repository permissions (allow/deny for principals) describe the metadata system, not the data; not converted.
